messages.subject: Project Onyx — completion statement and apportionments
messages.plaintextBody:
Zoe,

My draft completion statement attached for agreement. Balance due from buyer on completion is £16,338,957.50, reflecting the price less the deposit, plus rent and service-charge apportionments to 7 April, the rent deposits of £130,650 transferring to us, and the Unit D arrears of £12,987.50 assigned to the buyer. Please check the apportionment days (quarter 25 Mar–23 Jun) and revert with any comments.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0548
